assumptions.assumption: An opened selected alias directory may be identical to another fixed selected directory despite its parent entry being a SymbolicLink.
assumptions.basis: Exact CI SymbolicLink rejection plus four-ABI native same/distinct object observations, three portable tests and executed Windows acquisition adapter.
assumptions.dependent-result: Admit only the identity-proven fixed pair. Actual CI target remains unknown and may be outside this profile.
assumptions.stress-test: Same object, distinct object, missing metadata, type/name mismatch, DONT_REPARSE, reparse budget, canonical named-object identity and rights.
assumptions.falsification-probe: NtCompareObjects does not establish selected target identity, or actual CI alias resolves outside the fixed target profile.
assumptions.revisit-evidence: All complete3host library/CAPI/integration/all-target gates and retained consumers pass within exact5knownWindowsfailures; actual CI outcome remains unverified until publication.
